courses.title: MongoDB Management
courses.description: Model, query and manage real application data. Build confidence with documents, CRUD operations and aggregation pipelines.
courses.outcomes:
Design collections and documents
Write efficient queries and aggregation pipelines
Understand indexes and database performance

lessons.title: Documents & collections
lessons.body:
MongoDB stores data as flexible documents. A collection groups related documents, like a table groups rows. A document can contain nested objects and arrays.
Example: { name: "Alex", skills: ["MongoDB", "C#"] }.
Choose a structure that reflects how your application reads data.

lessons.title: Find your first document
lessons.body: Use the users collection to find a document with the name Alex. Complete the command: db.users.____({ name: "Alex" }). Enter the missing method.

lessons.title: Aggregation pipelines
lessons.body:
An aggregation pipeline processes documents in stages. $match filters documents; $group summarises them; $sort orders results.
Place selective filters early to reduce the amount of data passed to later stages.

lessons.title: Knowledge check
lessons.body: Check your understanding of MongoDB documents and pipelines.

questions.text: What helps speed up frequent queries?

courses.title: C# Foundations
courses.description: Learn the building blocks of C#: variables, control flow and reusable methods. Prepare for your first ASP.NET application.
courses.outcomes:
Use types and variables
Write reusable methods
Understand conditions and loops

lessons.title: Types & variables
lessons.body:
C# is a statically typed language. int stores whole numbers, string stores text and bool stores true or false.
For example: int score = 80; string name = "Alex";

lessons.title: Write to the console
lessons.body: Complete the C# statement Console.____("Hello"); Enter the missing method name.

lessons.title: C# essentials quiz
lessons.body: Test your knowledge of types and methods.

questions.text: Which type stores true or false?

courses.title: Data Science Essentials
courses.description: Explore clean datasets, meaningful visualisations and the questions behind useful analysis.
courses.outcomes:
Clean a dataset
Choose a clear visualisation
Explain insights responsibly

lessons.title: Ask a better question
lessons.body: Start analysis with a clear question. Identify the population, the measure and the time period. Check missing values before drawing conclusions.

lessons.title: Choose a chart
lessons.body: Pick a visualisation that matches the question.

courses.title: API Design with ASP.NET
courses.description: Design clear REST endpoints, validate requests and return consistent responses.
courses.outcomes:
Design REST endpoints
Validate API input
Handle HTTP errors

lessons.title: Resources & routes
lessons.body: A REST API exposes resources through URLs. Use GET to read and POST to create. Return a clear status code and structured validation errors.

courses.title: Inside a Computer
courses.description: Recognise the CPU, memory, storage and the role of an operating system.
courses.outcomes: Recognise the CPU, memory, storage and the role of an operating system.

lessons.title: Computer essentials
lessons.body: CPU carries out instructions. RAM holds data currently in use. Storage retains files when the power is off. The operating system coordinates these resources.

courses.title: Networks & the Web
courses.description: Trace how a browser reaches a website through a network.
courses.outcomes: Trace how a browser reaches a website through a network.

lessons.title: Networking
lessons.body: A client sends a request to a server. DNS translates a domain name to an IP address. HTTPS protects the connection while data travels between the browser and server.

courses.title: Working with Data
courses.description: Explore datasets and ask clear questions before analysing them.
courses.outcomes: Explore datasets and ask clear questions before analysing them.

lessons.title: Data literacy
lessons.body: Start with a question and inspect each column. Check missing values, units and duplicates. Keep an unchanged copy of the original dataset before cleaning it.

courses.title: AI Fundamentals
courses.description: Understand how models learn from examples and how to evaluate them.
courses.outcomes: Understand how models learn from examples and how to evaluate them.

lessons.title: AI foundations
lessons.body: Training data teaches a model patterns. Separate test data checks whether those patterns generalise to new examples. Evaluate errors and bias before using predictions.

posts.text: When should I use $match instead of find()? #MongoDB

replies.text: Use $match inside an aggregation pipeline. Use find() for a standalone query.
